products.title: Spider Glove
products.body_html:
Be the superhero of your round and defend yourself from bogeys with the Spider Glove from Chipp Golf Co! All of our gloves are made with premium cabretta leather and feature breathable holes on both sides of all fingers to ensure your hand stays cool and comfortable all round long. This glove also features a palm pad for extra style and support where you need it most. To ensure proper fit, please refer to our sizing guide.

10% of proceeds from the sale of this glove will be donated to First Tee whose mission is to teach life skills and build character in young people through the game of golf. Through its programs, it aims to help kids and teens develop core values such as integrity, respect, perseverance, and confidence, both on and off the course. Click here to learn more about all our charitable beneficiaries.

*Not an official partner of First Tee
